unit: records-preserving canonical eligibility digest connection and full-production parity rerun

connection.producer: The existing RankingEligibilityAuditAccumulator hashes the candidate eligibility record stream. It now keeps the same record order in eight canonical condition partitions so a full single run and the established eight-shard run produce the same digest.
connection.singleRun: The full audit streams each existing eligibility record into its canonical condition partition and combines the eight resulting digests in index order.
connection.shards: Each established shard retains its existing candidate eligibility digest. The merge validates shard identities 0..7 and combines those digests using the same owner; it does not rerun candidate generation or damage calculation.
connection.canonicalMatrix: Master-data owns the expected and actual tsk-06.5:production-matrix records. Both the connector and typed parity gate use that projection and read the actual eligibility digest from eligibility.candidates.digest.
connection.failureArtifact: Both scripts persist the complete available identity, audit, parity gate, first canonical difference, and failure reason to the run manifest before setting a non-zero exit status. Master checksum failures retain expected and actual SHA-256 values.

failureFixtures: matrix digest mismatch retains canonical identity, path, expected, and actual
eligibility digest mismatch and missing actual digest resolve to first path eligibilityDigest
parity failure retains the complete typed parity failure list
seven of eight eligibility partition digests and duplicate partition identities fail closed
master checksum mismatch exits non-zero and writes expected/actual checksum and failure reason to manifest
generic runner artifact tests reject missing, outside, byte-mismatched, and SHA-mismatched artifacts

singleProducerShard.note: The fresh shard's aggregate audit digest includes newly measured elapsedMs and differs from the historical run; all ten condition record digests, candidate inventories, outcomes, and parity counts match the historical shard.

singleUnshardedAttempt.reason: Two satisfied conditions took 135615.98ms and 152409.62ms individually. The serial run was canceled because the complete eight-shard merge already exercised all 80 production conditions and passed; this partial run is not parity success evidence. Single-path digest connection is covered by the shared existing accumulator, focused tests, and a real producer shard.

lint.command: pnpm exec eslint <changed calculation-application and master-data source and test files> --max-warnings=0
lint.scripts: calculation-application/scripts is excluded from the repository TypeScript project service; both scripts were executed directly and passed Prettier.

reusedEvidence.tsk06_5: canonical static semantics and candidate source inventory, original eight shard records, support status, 80-condition matrix, production output, and calculator/ranking/portable parity
reusedEvidence.tsk06_3: bounded summary, generic artifact declaration, and checksum verification ownership remain in the runner
reusedEvidence.tsk07: worker/cache, fingerprint, stale mutation, responsive/accessibility, and presentation evidence remain unchanged

stopConditions: TSK-06.5 source digest, candidate inventory, support status, production output, or parity differs
a canonical eligibility digest cannot be derived from the existing producer's ordered records
first canonical difference is unavailable or the merge accepts an incomplete/duplicate partition set
master identity or artifact checksum fails without a complete available failure manifest
eligibility digest is assigned from the source or another numeric fallback
candidate or damage semantics are recalculated to manufacture the missing digest
a new producer, generator, compatibility path, or semantic owner is required
unresolved: ratchet unsupported, invalid, partial commit, inert control, and stale mutation across the full production audit
remove the deferred legacy aggregate auditor and old loader/scan/candidate-list/duplicate fixtures
nextBoundedUnit: ratchet unsupported, invalid, partial commit, inert control, and stale mutation against this shared full-production audit model
